name: Potty Racers
author: Addicting Games
description: Potty Racers is a free launch game. They called him crazy. When he said he was going to be the first stick man to enter the porta potty racing and free jumping competition, they laughed. He was never trained, he was too old, he was being delusional. But this summer, he shows them all. Potty Racers is the inspirational story of one stick man who dared to dream, who dared to take a chance, to take a leap of faith --in a porta potty --off of a cliff. But, it's not just any porta-potty, it is a specialized racing porta-potty designed to move fast, get air, and make the distance. Take control of the stick man ss you charge down the hill and fly off the cliff you will gain money, money that you can use to upgrade your wheels or add an engine, add wings, add a parachute, add fuel, upgrade the fuel. Whatever kind of turbo-boosted upgrade you need is at the touch of your fingers.
